about: Lint runner and rule mutants (wf10 LINT0). Each is killed by the package's seeded properties: TestSuppressionAgreesWithModel (runner, configuration, directive grammar) and the per-rule reference properties.

mutants.name: lint0-unchecked-runs-rules
mutants.rule: On unchecked source no rule runs and every known directive is not-evaluated: unchecked-source.

mutants.name: lint0-covers-own-line
mutants.rule: A directive covers the next line, not its own.

mutants.name: lint0-unused-not-reported
mutants.rule: An unused suppression of a completed rule is an L001 error.

mutants.name: lint0-reserved-namespace-admitted
mutants.rule: A directive in a reserved namespace (ergo/, builtin/) is unknown: L001.

mutants.name: lint0-off-rule-unused
mutants.rule: A directive of an off rule is not-evaluated: rule-off, never unused.

mutants.name: lint0-failed-rule-unused
mutants.rule: A directive of a failed rule is not-evaluated: facts-unavailable; a rule that did not complete proves nothing unused.

mutants.name: lint0-failure-complete
mutants.rule: A failed rule makes the run incomplete, which fails policy.

mutants.name: lint0-panic-passes
mutants.rule: A rule that panics fails with L000; it never completes clean.

mutants.name: lint0-bad-span-passes
mutants.rule: A rule that reports outside its file fails with L000.

mutants.name: lint0-suppression-keeps-finding
mutants.rule: An applied directive removes the findings it covers.

mutants.name: lint0-severity-dropped

mutants.to: f.Code, f.Rule, f.Severity, f.Precision = rule.Code, rule.Name, rule.Default, precision
mutants.rule: A finding carries the configured severity, not the rule's default.

mutants.name: lint0-options-only-stays-off
mutants.rule: A setting with no severity turns an off rule on at its default.

mutants.name: lint0-presets-ignored
mutants.rule: The command line's presets are layers after extends and before the document's rules.

mutants.name: lint0-reason-optional
mutants.rule: A directive without a reason is malformed (L001).

mutants.name: lint0-two-rules-admitted
mutants.rule: A directive names one rule.

mutants.name: lint0-glued-word-directive
mutants.rule: A comment whose first word only starts with the directive word is no directive.

mutants.name: lint0-silent-return-ignored
mutants.rule: An arm that returns leaves a trace.

mutants.name: lint0-silent-try-ignored
mutants.rule: An arm that fails on through try leaves a trace.

mutants.name: lint0-silent-footprint-ignored
mutants.rule: An arm that calls anything with an effect leaves a trace.

mutants.name: lint0-silent-reads-ignored
mutants.rule: An arm that reads its failure binding is not silent.

mutants.name: lint0-silent-enters-literals
mutants.rule: A return inside a function literal is that literal's frame, not the arm's.

mutants.name: lint0-fep-unexported
mutants.rule: Only an exported function is a public boundary.

mutants.name: lint0-fep-any-error
mutants.rule: The rule matches go.Error by identity, not the program's own error types.

mutants.name: lint3-runner-crash-not-l000

mutants.name: as4-verbs-entry

mutants.name: as4-clump-failure

mutants.rule: A function that passes on a message holding a failure makes no failure.

mutants.name: as4-clump-one-partner
mutants.rule: A group in two places is mostly a helper and its caller; three places make a clump.

mutants.name: lh1-narr-doc-skip
mutants.rule: A doc comment, a member's too, names what it documents; only a comment in a body narrates.

mutants.name: lh1-narr-shared-off
mutants.rule: Two shared words make a restatement.

mutants.name: lh1-narr-half-off
mutants.rule: Half of the comment's words from the line make it a restatement.

mutants.name: lh1-narr-short-words
mutants.rule: Words of one or two letters (to, of, in) are not evidence of a restatement.

mutants.name: lh1-code-doc-skip

mutants.name: lh1-code-lone-operand
mutants.rule: One word of prose parses as a name; it is not code.

mutants.name: lh1-code-block-marks
mutants.rule: A block comment of code is code without its delimiters.

mutants.name: lh3-concat-declared-inside

mutants.name: lh3-quad-param-first
mutants.rule: The walk must be over the parameter the collection is passed to.

mutants.name: lh3-snap-any-order
mutants.rule: Only an argument after *s is evaluated after it.

mutants.name: lh3-quad-scans-ignored
mutants.rule: A Scans: paragraph says what a body Ergo cannot read does.

mutants.name: lh3-quad-scans-any-name
mutants.rule: Scans: names the parameter walked; another parameter is not.

mutants.name: lh3-quad-return
mutants.rule: A walk in a return runs once, not per turn.

mutants.name: sr1-purity
mutants.rule: A call with effects can give another value each time: no derived form.

mutants.rule: A write whose variant is not visible, or an assignment of one field, hides the pairing.

mutants.name: sr2-no-other
mutants.rule: A driver that is always the one variant tells nothing apart.

mutants.name: sr3-run
mutants.rule: A term of several words is avoided as a run of the name's words, not by its first word.

mutants.name: sr3-unread
mutants.rule: A glossary that cannot be read refuses the configuration.

mutants.name: sr3-use
mutants.rule: The finding names the glossary's term to use.

mutants.name: sr5-guard
mutants.rule: A law guarded by more than the empty case states nothing for the inputs its guard returns early on.

mutants.name: sr5-type
mutants.rule: A law holds at the argument types it was tested at only.

mutants.name: sr5-other-read
mutants.rule: A let read for more than its ends and length is needed whole.

mutants.name: sr5-end
mutants.rule: A take at an index other than the first or the last is no end a law states.

mutants.name: sr6-reads
mutants.rule: A second wait that reads what the first binds must wait for it.

mutants.name: sr6-known
mutants.rule: A call whose footprint is unknown (a function value) makes no wait: what it touches is not known.

mutants.name: sr6-empty
mutants.rule: A let that exercises no capability waits for nothing.

mutants.name: sr6-leave
mutants.rule: A first wait that may leave early runs the second only when it does not.

mutants.name: sr7-value
mutants.rule: Two constants of the same kind but another value make a failing assert, not a restated one.

mutants.name: sr7-between
mutants.rule: A statement between two equal asserts may change what the second reads.

mutants.name: sr7-name
mutants.rule: A package let's name stands for its constant initializer.

mutants.name: gl-layer-order
mutants.rule: An import goes up the layering when its package is in an earlier (higher) layer than the importer's.

mutants.name: gl-entry
mutants.rule: A binary's entry chooses implementations: its imports of them are no finding.

mutants.name: gl-testfile
mutants.rule: A file of tests may import an implementation, as it may bind one.

mutants.name: gl-own-optype
mutants.rule: A package that declares an operation type is a domain package even when it implements another's.

mutants.name: gl-reexport-imported
mutants.rule: A use through a re-export of a package the user's package also imports hides nothing.

mutants.name: gl-file-reach
mutants.rule: A use of another file is a file cycle only when that file's uses come back.

mutants.name: gl-fix-qualifier
mutants.rule: The fix names the declaring package by its package name.

mutants.name: gl-fix-import
mutants.rule: The fix imports the declaring package when the file does not.

mutants.name: gl-drop-once
mutants.rule: fix --lint drops the imports its fixes leave unused in every package, also one that imports another whose import it drops.

mutants.name: gl-text
mutants.from: "this import goes up the layering: "+to+" is above "+from
mutants.rule: A layer finding names the package imported and the importer.

mutants.name: gl-unit-path
mutants.rule: The rows name the run's root package by its import path, not the checker's "main".

mutants.name: gl-domain-only
mutants.rule: Only a domain package, one that declares an operation type, is held to importing no implementation.

mutants.name: gl-ctor-file
mutants.rule: A file of the test build's row-free constructors and helpers only tests and laws use is test code to the graph rules.

mutants.name: gl-ctor-file-used
mutants.rule: A file whose function the package's code uses is no test code.

mutants.name: cochange-no-skip
mutants.rule: A commit of more than 50 files is no evidence of co-change.

mutants.name: cochange-twice
mutants.rule: A pair is counted once per commit, in one order.

mutants.name: cochange-no-dedup
mutants.rule: A path listed twice in one commit counts once.
